corrected_value.title: Machine learning to analyze single-case graphs: A comparison to visual inspection.

decisions.quote: A secondary purpose was to replicate and extend Lanovaz and Hranchuk (2021) by examining correspondence between visual inspection, the conservative dual-criteria method, and the machine-learning algorithms on a novel dataset. We extended both studies by using clinical data and adding a 10-point scale with definitional criteria to visual-inspection ratings.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly define a secondary purpose as replicating Lanovaz and Hranchuk (2021) on new clinical data, distinct from the primary Wolfe et al. (2018) comparison. The reference identifies DOI 10.1002/jaba.863; the sole shipped pair is Wolfe (10.1002/jaba.453). Parent reviewed the cited results/purpose and reference identity against all supplied shipped originals. This decision confirms the missing paper-level pair only; its overall outcome has not been adjudicated.
